purpose: Screen exactly one million typed research-question challenge cells as a finite evidence-bounded projection. Cells are not hypotheses, mechanisms, novelty claims, or experiment authorizations.

evidence_snapshot.feedback_rule: Every listed evidence change invalidates the instance root. Digest-bound reviews are summarized by base ID, but no label automatically clears a hard gate or creates hot state.

expansion.uniqueness_rule: Every axis has unique stable IDs and every base has a unique typed semantic anchor; the encoded Cartesian tuple is therefore injective. This proves typed identity only, not semantic novelty.

identity_contract.scientific_signature_sha256: Content address of the normalized base question, mechanism obligation, cost bridge, decisive test, adversarial challenge, and threat model. Operator IDs and batch order are excluded.
identity_contract.evaluation_instance_sha256: Hash of the scientific signature and the evidence-bound space instance root. Evidence or policy drift invalidates this ID without changing an otherwise unchanged scientific signature.
identity_contract.batch_occurrence_ordinal: Mixed-radix position in the frozen sorted Cartesian projection. It is operational provenance, never scientific identity.
identity_contract.review_binding: A future native review must bind all three identities plus the evidence snapshot and policy digest; this release imports no v2 review as independent evidence.

adversarial_challenges.label: Prove that the mechanism remains inside the classical plain single-target threat model
Bind every required property to an exact secp256k1 value and provenance anchor
Compare the exact claim with full-text primary prior art and record unread sources
Specify map, domain, codomain, fixed-target semantics, and exceptional locus
Specify inverse recovery, orbit tags, excluded components, and spurious branches
Expose offline work, conditioned inputs, amortization, and reusable setup
Bridge the changed quantity to full online, offline, memory, storage, and recovery cost
Distinguish a growing asymptotic lever from a constant-factor or encoding effect
Recompute the decisive claim from raw artifacts with path, artifact, and source separation
Name the new premise that escapes an exact prior barrier without widening the claim

map_contract.cold: A typed cell rejected by at least one deterministic structural gate.
map_contract.warm: A structurally coherent research-question cell that still lacks an assured exact mechanism and independent source review.
map_contract.hot: A cell with an assured mechanism, cost bridge, and independent review. This generator cannot create hot cells.
map_contract.coverage_boundary: Coverage is complete only for this frozen finite Cartesian projection. It is not coverage of all ECDLP ideas or literature.

performance_contract.reason: Wall-clock throughput is hardware-dependent; the benchmark reports the target without weakening deterministic correctness gates.
